info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Corporate Finance By Param1-spec
info.description: The Corporate Finance Retrieval API provides access to detailed information regarding public offerings in corporate finance by using specific parameters. This endpoint allows users to query financial data related to public offerings, making it essential for financial analysts, investment professionals, and business strategists. By providing key insights, the API supports informed decision-making and market analysis. Typical use cases include retrieving financial metrics and trends associated with specific public offerings, enabling users to stay ahead in the competitive financial landscape.

get.summary: Retrieve details for the specified public offering.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch comprehensive information about a specific public offering identified by its resource number. It provides relevant data that can be used for analysis, reporting, or decision-making regarding corporate finance activities.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding the public offering identified by the resource ID RES-100045. It expects a JSON payload that conforms to the specified schema.
